title: The Hebrew alef-bet: alef, bet, gimel with ancient letters, meanings, values
summary: First three rows of a Hebrew alef-bet chart (with final forms): alef (strength, God, value 1), bet (tent, house, value 2) and gimel (camel, value 3), each shown in modern Hebrew, in its ancient picture-form and with its meaning and gematria value.

text.text: 1. א alef A | (ancient glyph) | Strength, God | 1
2. ב bet B | (ancient glyph) | Tent, House | 2

pictures.description: Column of three ancient (paleo-Hebrew) letter shapes, each sitting on a short coloured bar matching its modern letter: a rounded animal-head shape on a blue bar (alef), a boxy house-like shape on a red bar (bet), and a check-mark-like shape on a gold bar (gimel).

uncertain: Only rows 1-3 of the alef-bet chart are visible on this slide.
